question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**Serving**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the role of nursing as a profession that involves helping and caring for patients.
 
• The appropriate verb should reflect an action that aligns with assisting or taking care of others.
 
• "**Serving**" fits well as it conveys the idea of providing care and assistance to patients.
 
• Other options ("**Deceiving**", "**Hosting**", "**Preventing**") do not align with the context of nursing as a noble and compassionate profession.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Deceiving (धोखा देना): "Deceiving" means misleading or tricking someone, which does not fit the context of nursing.
 
• Hosting (मेजबानी करना): "Hosting" means entertaining or receiving guests, which is not suitable for describing patient care.
 
• Preventing (रोकना): "Preventing" means stopping something from happening, which does not accurately reflect the act of caring for patients.
